## Project overview

This project explores associations between HEXACO personality traits
and teamwork quality using questionnaire data.

It also includes a Shiny app for exploring observed relationships and
simulating hypothetical team-formation strategies. Simulated outcomes
reflect assumptions, not proven effects on real teams.

## Data and scoring

The dataset contains 54 respondents and includes personality and
teamwork-quality questionnaire items.

The scoring rules and treatment of missing responses must be checked
against the study documentation before interpreting results.

## Statistical analysis

The analysis below examines the association between agreeableness
and reported communication quality.

```{r analysis}
source("data_processing.R")     # GIVES ERROR 
#                            Warning in file(file, "rt") :
#                            cannot open file 'data/HEXACO_TWQ_raw-data.csv': No such file or directory
#                            Error in file(file, "rt") : cannot open the connection
summary(model)
print(communication_plot)
```

This analysis is exploratory. The model does not account for
participants belonging to the same team, and the variables were
selected after examining correlations.

## Simulation

The simulation generates hypothetical HEXACO profiles and teamwork-quality
outcomes under different team-formation strategies. Its results depend on
the assumptions and settings in the script; they are not estimates of proven
effects in real teams.

The simulation logic is shared with the Shiny app through
`outputs/simulation_core.R`.

To generate the simulated data, run this code from the project root:

```{r run-simulation, eval=FALSE}
source("outputs/data_simulation_fixed.R")
```

Generated files are saved in the `simulated_data/` folder.

## Interactive app

The Shiny app lets users explore the observed questionnaire data and compare
hypothetical team-formation strategies using simulated data.

To launch it from the project root in R, run:

```{r launch-app, eval=FALSE}
shiny::runApp("outputs")
```

The app uses `outputs/app.R` and the shared simulation logic in
`outputs/simulation_core.R`. `outputs/sample_observed_upload.csv` is a sample
file for trying the data-upload feature.

## Project files

- `data_processing.R` — prepares and analyzes the observed questionnaire data.
- `outputs/data_simulation_fixed.R` — generates simulated data files.
- `outputs/simulation_core.R` — shared simulation functions used by the simulation script and app.
- `outputs/app.R` — Shiny app for exploring observed and simulated data.
- `outputs/sample_observed_upload.csv` — sample CSV for testing uploads.

## Limitations

Participants are grouped within existing teams, which must be
considered when choosing and interpreting the statistical analysis.
Observed associations do not establish causation.
